title: Wren's Rope
summary: Someone cut Wren's line and left her on a ledge. Get her down, then find out what happened to her crate.
ask: Wren: Hi! Hello. Up here. Please don't laugh.
Wren: Somebody cut my line. I had a crate of bell bronze for the city, and now I have a ledge.

steps.text: Get Wren down with your rope
steps.needs_text: Wren's ledge is a rope's reach. You'll need the Tether to bring her down.
done: Wren: Oh, that's a good rope. Okay. Don't look down. I'm looking down.
Wren: The crate went over when the line went. It must be down there somewhere.
Splinters and straw. No crate. Three sets of boot prints, heading away from the road.

steps.text: Tell Wren the crate is gone
done: Wren: Taken? Out here? Nobody walks out here but Runners and idiots.
Wren: The Association has to hear about this. Here, my spare hook. It throws further than the Guild ones. Don't tell them I said so.
